plan.bench_condition: User confirms 12.6 V setpoint, increased bench current limit to 3 A, and all nine shafts free for continuous rotation without linkage, cable, or physical stops. Unloaded HX-30HM firmware 3.15 IDs 4-12. This experiment retains short bounded pulses; total bench current is not independently logged. Bench observed CV at 12.6 V and up to 0.9 A during prior group pulses. Free-rotation encoder ambiguity bound 8192 counts/s (720 deg/s) is provisional acquisition policy, not measured maximum.

limitations: Plateau compares encoder slopes in the last two half-second windows; it is a finite-duration repeatability criterion, not proof of a physical maximum.
Sensor timestamps are host request/reply windows. Current and connector voltage are not independently calibrated.
Displacement ends at the last stationary rest sample. Only fully completed trials are summarized.
